description: Disha Shool and Rahu Vasa direction by weekday, against DrikPanchang's Kathmandu tables. Pure lookup tables - no astronomy - but they were wrong once (Rahu Vasa was a copy of Disha Shool) and the error was invisible without an external table.

source.reference: Kathmandu weekday tables; carried forward from tests/test_nivas_shool.py.
source.verified_by: Established while fixing payload-version 19: Rahu Vasa is a distinct 8-direction weekday cycle and coincides with Disha Shool only on Thursday.
source.notes: Cultural lookup rather than astronomy, but included because an external table is the only thing that can verify it.
source.convention: Direction by civil weekday, where the day boundary is sunrise (udaya), Kathmandu. Disha Shool and Rahu Vasa are independent cycles; Rahu Vasa is an 8-direction cycle coinciding with Disha Shool only on Thursday.

tolerance.rationale: Direction labels are discrete lookups. Any difference is a table error, not a precision difference.
